name: codex-push-hooks
description: Tiered push notifications for Codex CLI — macOS, Bark, Telegram, Feishu, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, Pushover, ntfy, Gotify

interface.longDescription: Tiered push notifications for Codex CLI. Short-delay channels (macOS/Bark/Telegram/Pushover/ntfy/Gotify) reach you within seconds, and fallback channels (WeCom/Feishu/DingTalk/Slack/Discord) follow up after a few minutes. Queued pushes are cancelled automatically once you respond, so you are never interrupted twice.
